title: Imperial Valley Desert Museum

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: The Imperial Valley Desert Museum’s permanent exhibits celebrate the beauty of the Valley and the perseverance of the people who call it home. From Kumeyaay pottery and tools to the innovations of modern agriculture, visitors can explore the diverse histories and cultures that have shape our desert. Visit IVDM today and discover the stories of the Imperial Valley. When the desert heat makes outdoor exploration a challenge, this immersive projected panorama brings the landscape to you! Discover more than eight remarkable destinations across Imperial County and eastern San Diego County, including the Yuha Desert, Jacumba Wilderness Area, and the Algodones Sand Dunes.
